newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SHARES END FLAT ON THIN TRADING VOLUME.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SHARES END FLAT ON THIN TRADING VOLUME.

text.p: Greek stocks continued to trade
narrowly and finished virtually unchanged on Tuesday as blue
chips which had pushed the market 0.81 percent higher in early
dealings turned back towards the end of the session.
Brokers said trading volume on the Athens bourse wound down
due to the summer holiday doldrums that kept the market from
embarking on a clear trend.
"The market operates well below capacity as investors have
lost their appetite for trading as we have entered the vacation
season," said Alexis Panagiotopoulos, broker at InterSec.
"Turnover has dropped considerably and the benchmark index
hovers around current levels as there is no clear imbalance
between buyers and sellers," he added.
But the lack of trading interest was a seasonal phenomenon
which was expected to disappear in August, with blue chips
leading the market higher again.
"Investors will be out on the prawl again for equities in
the second half of August and momentum will start to build up
again," Panagiotopoulos said. "But banks and industrials will be
the top picks at that time and lead the next leg of the rally."
Short-term rates on the interbank market, pushed higher last
week by a brief episode of drachma weakness, continued to slip
on Tuesday.
The one-month Athibor, Greece's reference interbank rate,
eased further, dropping to 12.34 percent from Monday's 12.58
percent.
But the dollar/drachma rate was fixed at a new all-time high
283.61 from Monday's 282.00 drachma.
The Athens general index finished 0.01 percent or 0.12
points higher at 1,535.81 from Monday's 1,535.69 close.
Industrials were up 0.58 percent offseting a 0.34 percent
loss in banks. Other sectors were mixed.
Turnover reached 9.4 billion drachmas on volume of 3.0
million shares.
Block trading included 100,000 shares of Alpha Leasing
traded at 7,320/50 drachmas and 24,000 shares of
Sidenor at 13,500.
Advancers led decliners 109 to 93 with 27 shares unchanged
on 229 traded.
